124:
125:    sum = 0;
126:    p = header->charptr;
127:    ep = header->charptr + sizeof(*header);
128:    while (p < ep)
129:            sum += *p++;
130:
131:    /* Adjust checksum to count the "chksum" field as blanks. */
132:    for (i = 0; i < sizeof(header->header.chksum); i++)
133:            sum -= header->header.chksum[i];
134:    sum += ' ' * sizeof(header->header.chksum);
135:
136:    if (sum != recsum)
137:            return 0;       /* Not a tar archive */

141:            return 3;               /* GNU Unix Standard tar archive */
